title: growth.odin comment overclaims 'E31 by construction' for the outward-bias draw — diagonal directions can exceed the picked router's span
detail: For the 4 diagonal unit vectors, pos sits dist·√2 from the picked router (up to span·√2 ≈ 19.8 at era-1 span 14) — NOT 'within the connectable radius... by construction'. E31 actually holds via the growth_connectable rejection check. A future 'simplification' trusting this comment could break E31.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment: diagonal candidates can land beyond the picked router's span; E31 is enforced by the growth_connectable check below, which is therefore NOT redundant.

title: growth.odin claims its read-only topology rule is 'structural, same as demand.odin' but it receives a mutable ^Topology
detail: demand.odin's purity is structural because it receives NO topology handle; growth_plan_pressure receives ^Topology, so its read-only-ness is discipline, not structure. The 'same as demand.odin' claim misstates the ODN-7 M1 guarantee the lens guards.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment: growth takes ^Topology by discipline (mutation stays in Topology via growth_apply); a snapshot/const view would make it structural — note as a future seam hardening.

title: e31_recheck excludes the spawn's own node but not pipes incident to it — a player-drawn pipe to a growth spawn false-fails the end-of-run E31 audit
detail: A pipe whose endpoint is the audited spawn has perpendicular distance 0 to pos, so growth_pipe_sep_ok returns false — a false 'violates E31' failure once any test/demo connects a growth-spawned terminal. Spawn-time validity did hold; the incident pipe postdates the spawn.
recommended_fix: In e31_recheck, skip live pipes whose resolved a/b endpoint slot equals self_slot (mirror the node-loop self-exclusion) before the pipe-separation check.
